findings.current: The Big Man’s final mutterings, heard only by the desert and the darkness, had been half right and half wrong.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the established name 대인 with “The Big Man.”
findings.rationale: The binding glossary renders 대인 as Great Sir; the draft uses “The Big Man” for him throughout.
findings.replacement: Great Sir’s final mutterings, heard only by the desert and the darkness, had been half right and half wrong.
findings.source: 사막과 어둠만이 들었던 대인의 마지막 뇌까림은 반은 맞고, 반은 틀렸다.

findings.current: “Pick some men and search the surrounding area. No—go ahead. I have something important to discuss with Great Hero Song here.”
findings.defect: “No—go ahead” loses Wikyung’s deliberate correction from a familiar command to a more formal one after Mukyung insists on being addressed as Commander.
findings.rationale: 하거라 becomes 하게; the change in address continues the brothers’ public-formality joke.
findings.replacement: “Pick some men and search the surrounding area. No—Commander, please see to it. I need to speak privately with Great Hero Song.”
findings.source: “인원을 선별하여 인근을 수색하거라. 아니, 하게. 나는 여기 계신 송 대협과 긴히 나눌 이야기가 있으니.”

findings.current: That included even his youngest brother, despite thinking the man was every bit as finicky as his own master.
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung judge Great Sir to be finicky. The source makes Wikyung judge Taekyung to be as finicky as Taekyung’s master.
findings.rationale: The modifying clause describes 막내아우, not Taekyung’s opinion of 대인.
findings.replacement: Even his youngest brother, whom Jin Wikyung thought just as finicky as his master, liked him.
findings.source: 혈육으로서 아끼는 마음과는 별개로, 그 스승만큼이나 매우 까탈스러운 성격을 지녔다고 생각하는 막내아우조차도.

findings.current: The moment he heard those four words, Jin Wikyung felt his hand tighten around the reins.
findings.defect: “Tianshan Mountains” is not four English words; the literal count creates a false detail in the reading copy.
findings.rationale: 네 글자 counts the four Korean characters in 천산산맥, not four English words.
findings.replacement: The moment he heard the name, Jin Wikyung felt his hand tighten around the reins.
findings.source: 그 네 글자를 듣는 순간, 진위경은 말고삐를 쥔 손에 힘이 들어가는 것을 느꼈다.

summary: The draft largely follows the scene, but changes one character judgment, misses a deliberate shift in formality, and uses the wrong established name for Great Sir.
